articles.summary: NEW YORK--(BUSINESS WIRE)-- Voya Financial, Inc. (NYSE: VOYA) announced today that its board of directors has declared a 21% increase in the company’s common stock dividend to $0.57 per share from $0.47 per share for the fourth quarter of 2026. The common stock dividend is payable on December 29, 2026, to shareholders of record as of November 24, 2026.
articles.title: Voya Financial increases common dividend and declares preferred stock dividend
